title: De-risk WKWebView video rendering continuously at desktop level on Tahoe
description: The ow-mbw.1 spike de-risks an AppKit + CoreAnimation desktop-level window, but the product render path (DEC-001) is a looping <video> inside a transparent WKWebView, which uses a different compositor path (IOSurface / render-server) that macOS has historically throttled independently. A green AppKit/CA spike does NOT prove the real wallpaper keeps animating. This task validates: a muted+playsinline looping <video> in a transparent WKWebView, pinned at CGWindowLevelForKey(.desktopWindow), keeps decoding and compositing new frames continuously on macOS 26 (behind icons, click-through, all Spaces, and crucially after >=2 minutes with another app frontmost, i.e. not frozen by occlusion or App Nap). Reuse the validated window factory from ow-mbw.1.
design: Throwaway env-gated (OW_WEBSPIKE=1) WebKit de-risk, mutually exclusive with OW_SPIKE. NEW WebSpikeWindow.swift (only file allowed WKWebView): copies the measured ow-mbw.1 window property table (NOT makeSpikeWindow) with isOpaque=false + backgroundColor=.clear; WKWebViewConfiguration.mediaTypesRequiringUserActionForPlayback=[] (NOT allowsInlineMediaPlayback, iOS-only); transparency via underPageBackgroundColor=.clear + CSS (NO drawsBackground KVC, private); loadFileURL(allowingReadAccessTo:); telemetry via WKScriptMessageHandler; polls WKMediaPlaybackState; logs webViewWebContentProcessDidTerminate; enumerates PID-owned on-screen windows and flags any layer >= desktop-icon level. Throwaway web/webspike/{index.html,style.css,app.js}: full-bleed muted playsinline loop autoplay video, no controls, disablepictureinpicture, disableremoteplayback, filter: brightness(1.01) (DEC-001 chose WKWebView FOR filters; a filter forces the freezable backing-store recomposite, so test WITH a filter). Oracle: machine-readable COLOR BLOCK driven by frame# burned into the VIDEO (not a JS HUD) in a known center-fraction crop; RVFC presented-frame counter; postMessage telemetry only. Asset: ffmpeg H.264 yuv420p 1920x1080@30, 17.3s (non-divisor of 120), -an (NO audio: a silent track can hold a media power assertion that masks App Nap), color-block + human digits, generated into .build/webspike/ (NOT in-tree).
acceptance_criteria: A transparent WKWebView desktop-layer window shows a continuously playing video behind icons that is still advancing after a >=2 minute occluded watch on AC power.
notes: PASS with benign occlusion nuance. The WKWebView <video> at the desktop layer keeps presenting frames continuously whenever its Space is visible: WebKit does NOT throttle the hidden/occluded page (RVFC presentedFrames advance with document.visibilityState=hidden, media=playing for 125s, no WebContent termination). Proven on glass by screencapture -l showing the burned-in counter advancing. Direct Phase 5 observation (Anoop): visible wallpaper animates (incl. behind a same-Space maximized window); a display taken into its own full-screen Space pauses (macOS occlusion/Space culling) and RESUMES live on return (not frozen). So screencapture -l of a 100%-occluded window is not a freeze oracle (it measures compositor culling); the authoritative liveness signals are RVFC + media=playing + a VISIBLE window animating, all of which passed. 4 cold Codex passes; final adjudication: transparency gating REJECTED (by design, a reported finding for ow-94b.1); z-order actual-layer assert + OW_WEBSPIKE_ACTIVITY env hygiene FIXED; per-window-telemetry-id, cmp-byte-diff, and foreground-app-assertion documented as known throwaway-check limitations (authoritative oracle is direct observation + per-window pixel gate + RVFC). Follow-ups: multi-display slice sync across pause/resume (ow-blz.5); true idle App Nap not exercised (ow-aad.1). Findings: ow-local/systems/web-render/webview-video-spike-findings.md.
close_reason: De-risk PASS: a looping, filtered, muted <video> in a transparent WKWebView at the desktop window level keeps presenting frames continuously on Tahoe whenever its Space is visible (WebKit does not throttle the occluded/hidden page; RVFC + media=playing sustained 125s; proven on glass). Fully-hidden windows pause via macOS occlusion culling and resume live (benign). Validated by direct observation + automated gates. Seeds ow-94b.1. title: Rebuild on display hot-plug / arrangement change
description: Observe NSApplication.didChangeScreenParametersNotification; tear down and rebuild all windows with recomputed geometry.
design:
FINAL (Opus + Codex co-scope + Grok red-team; Grok's 11 objections ALL ACCEPTED, a redesign from candidate-recreation to IN-PLACE update).
WHY NOT RECREATE: a new WKWebView hidden behind the old one has its WindowServer backing store culled (ow-94b.5), so revealing it shows the opaque black base for >=1 composite = black flash; also restarts video at t=0 on every nudge. REJECTED.
ARCHITECTURE (in-place):
1. Observe NSApplication.didChangeScreenParametersNotification (main actor, resnapshot NSScreen.screens, ignore userInfo) + NSWorkspace screensDidWakeNotification; both call one scheduleRefresh(). Do NOT rebuild on sleep. (Phase 5 must verify the notification even fires for our LSUIElement/accessory app on hot-plug; if missed, add CGDisplayRegisterReconfigurationCallback as a debounce-only kick, still snapshotting NSScreen.)
2. Coalesce ~0.3-0.5s, latest snapshot wins.
3. EMPTY-CONFIRM (critical, fixes a daily sleep/wake blank): an empty snapshot NEVER commits on first look; arm a 1-2s confirm timer; commit empty only if still empty when it fires; any non-empty cancels; generation-guard the callback.
4. NO-OP via pure arrangementChanged(old,new) over descriptors {displayID, frame(points), backingScaleFactor, pixel size}. displayID is identity; never match on the ?? 0 fallback.
5. DIFF BY displayID, same main-actor turn: missing IDs -> close window + log ONLYWALLPAPERS_RETIRE win= (retire promptly so AppKit does not relocate an orphaned window onto a surviving screen); surviving IDs -> window.setFrame(newScreenFrame) + webView runtime geometry apply; new IDs -> construct WebWallpaperView+WallpaperWindow like build() + orderFrontRegardless (behaves like first launch, its glass was empty).
6. RUNTIME GEOMETRY APPLY: export wallpaper.js geometry IIFE as window.__applyWallpaperGeometry(g) using the SAME left/top writes (transform on the video parent blanks the hardware layer - forbidden). Swift calls it via evaluateJavaScript with the new {stageW,stageH,offX,offY}; also update window.__wallpaperApplied so the applied-oracle reflects new geometry. Document-start injection stays for first paint only. Accept one possibly-mis-cropped frame (still a playing frame, keeps currentTime).
7. GENERATION only to drop late JS completions + late empty-confirms.
REFACTORS: WallpaperWindow init(frame: CGRect, contentView:) (frame is the only field used) so tests drive geometry without fake NSScreen; build() split into initialBuild + the shared commit path.
TELEMETRY: gen= on EVERY line the oracles parse (WINDOWS, SLICE, WEB loaded, WEB applied); ONLYWALLPAPERS_REBUILD gen reason=initial|screens-changed|wake|noop old new; ONLYWALLPAPERS_RETIRE win=. Pre-commit lines suppressed or distinct-prefixed.
TESTS (honest split): (a) pure computeLayout T-shape/vertical/union-change -> ow-blz.4; (b) pure arrangementChanged + the debounce/empty-confirm/generation REDUCER with TABLES (T-change, no-op, empty/empty commits, empty/non-empty never commits empty, stale timeout dropped, no-op during pending); (c) process-inject gate that POSTS THE REAL NSApplication.didChangeScreenParametersNotification, snapshot source = OW_FAKE_SCREENS_FILE when set else NSScreen (frames for math/logs ONLY, NEVER create AppKit windows at fake off-glass rects), asserting observer ran + two signals 50ms apart coalesce to one + no-op on unchanged + gen bump + RETIRE lines; (d) Phase 5 on the REAL T-arrangement for no-flash + offY-on-glass (the only flash oracle this repo trusts). smoke-run.sh lines 17-19 currently REJECT didChangeScreenParametersNotification as a forbidden symbol -> fix; make smoke/webdir/package-check select the committed gen=.
UNTOUCHED: status item, accessory policy, SIGINT, OW_WEBSPIKE. BOUNDARIES: ow-blz.4 exhaustive geometry tests; ow-blz.5 cross-display frame sync.
notes: Phase 5 PHYSICAL CONFIRMED by user (2026-10-06): plugged a 3rd display into the real T-arrangement while running; the two big screens came on/stayed smooth with no black flash and no video restart (survivors kept the SAME window numbers 15982/15983, updated in place), and the new bottom screen (Display-1, 1920x1080 at y=-1080) got a new window (16060) with the correct T-shape geometry: union grew to 7680x3240 (taller), bottom offX=2837 offY=2160 (the first real-hardware exercise of the nonzero-Y / Y-flip math, landed perfectly). User: 'yeah it worked fine, it just came on fine, still works fine right now'. Seamless in-place hot-plug rebuild VERIFIED end to end.
close_reason: In-place hot-plug rebuild implemented and all gates passing: swift build -Xswiftc -warnings-as-errors clean, smoke-run.sh PASS, webdir-check.sh PASS, rebuild-check.sh PASS (32/32 selftests, T-shape offY=2160, coalesce, noop). Phase 5 visual verification pending.

title: Inject slice geometry into web layer + stage transform
description: Inject window.__wallpaper {stageW,stageH,offX,offY} at document start; wallpaper.js sizes #stage to the union and translates by (-offX,-offY) so each screen shows its slice.
design: SLICE via LEFT/TOP positioning, NOT transform (Grok #8: ancestor transform on the video parent can blank/freeze the hardware video layer; left/top avoids it and makes getBoundingClientRect().left==-offX a clean oracle). WallpaperController.build(): pass geo into WebWallpaperView(... geometry: geo); window/view frames UNCHANGED; offX/offY never on AppKit. WebWallpaperView.swift: init gains geometry: WallpaperSliceGeometry. BEFORE super.init: ROUND stageW/H/offX/offY to nearest point; if any non-finite -> do NOT inject, log 'ONLYWALLPAPERS_WEB_GEOMETRY ... injection=skipped reason=..', still loadFileURL (JS falls back to 100%). Else build payload [String:Double], JSON via JSONSerialization (try?, not try!), add WKUserScript(source: 'window.__wallpaper = <json>;', injectionTime: .atDocumentStart, forMainFrameOnly: true) [3-arg = PAGE world]. In didFinish (when windowNumber exists): log 'ONLYWALLPAPERS_WEB_GEOMETRY win=.. gW=.. gH=.. gX=.. gY=..', and evaluateJavaScript reading window.__wallpaperApplied (the page-side snapshot wallpaper.js writes) -> log flat 'ONLYWALLPAPERS_WEB applied win=.. left=.. top=.. width=.. height=..'; on JS error log applied=fail. web/style.css: #stage position:fixed; left:0; top:0; width:100%; height:100%; overflow:hidden; background:#000 (JS overrides left/top/width/height when geometry valid); NO transform/transform-origin; #bg,#overlay unchanged (fill #stage); keep object-fit:cover object-position:center filter:brightness(1.01). web/wallpaper.js: TWO IIFEs. NEW geometry IIFE FIRST: var stage=getElementById('stage'); if(!stage) return; var g=window.__wallpaper; if g is object with typeof number && isFinite for stageW/H (>0) & offX/offY: stage.style.left=(-g.offX)+'px'; top=(-g.offY)+'px'; width=g.stageW+'px'; height=g.stageH+'px'; and set window.__wallpaperApplied={left:-g.offX, top:-g.offY, width:g.stageW, height:g.stageH}; else leave 100% (fallback) and set __wallpaperApplied from getBoundingClientRect. Then the EXISTING autoplay IIFE byte-for-byte (unchanged). index.html/WallpaperWindow/AppDelegate UNCHANGED. scripts/generate-test-bg.sh: add a FULL-SPAN static ruler (vertical rule at x=w/2, horizontal at y=h/2) for a spatial continuity join independent of image center; keep F{n} + box for liveness. smoke-run.sh: keep media=playing (1.0/2.5/7.5) regression gate + SLICE + window checks; ADD: poll up to ~2s for N 'ONLYWALLPAPERS_WEB applied' lines BEFORE SIGINT; per win join to SLICE and assert left==-offX, top==-offY, width==stageW, height==stageH (awk, eps 0.5); gW/gH/gX/gY match SLICE; shape-guard wallpaper.js contains __wallpaper and stage.style and #stage position:fixed in css. Boundaries: geometry from blz.1; blz.3 RECREATES a new WebWallpaperView(geometry:) (no in-page setter); no moods (Epic D); #filePath (94b.3); temporal sync (blz.5). Rely on position:fixed+overflow:hidden+the left/top assertion for clipping (no private scroll API).
acceptance_criteria: On a multi-monitor setup each screen shows its correct portion of one continuous canvas.
notes: Done (zero BLOCKING across 2 cold Codex passes). The one video now spans all displays: each per-screen WebWallpaperView injects window.__wallpaper via a document-start WKUserScript (page world; rounded; skip+reason on non-finite), and wallpaper.js (a geometry IIFE separate from autoplay) sizes #stage to the union and positions it by LEFT/TOP (NOT transform: a transform on the video parent can blank the hardware layer). Verified on two 3840x2160 displays: the native applied read-back (getBoundingClientRect on #stage, a REAL DOM oracle not an input echo) shows left=0 (left screen, offX=0) and left=-3840 (right screen, offX=3840), same stageW=7680 - i.e. each screen shows its adjacent slice of the single canvas. object-fit:cover crops once in union space (continuous across the bezel). Y-flip CORRECTNESS is blz.1's computeLayout (blz.4 unit tests the nonzero-Y cases the aligned hardware cannot exercise); blz.2 APPLIES it (top=-offY) and the oracle verifies the apply. Test clip gained a full-span crosshair for a spatial-join visual. Known-limitations updated (union-sized composited layers; cover-crop band). blz.3 must RECREATE a new WebWallpaperView(geometry:) (no in-page setter). Temporal sync is ow-blz.5.
close_reason: The one video is sliced across all displays: per-screen window.__wallpaper injected at document start, wallpaper.js positions #stage by left/top to each screen's slice. Verified by a real DOM applied oracle (getBoundingClientRect left==-offX: left=0 and left=-3840 on a 7680 union) and zero-BLOCKING review. Spatial spanning done; temporal sync is ow-blz.5. Unblocks ow-aqx.1/.2 (moods/config).

title: WallpaperController: union canvas + per-screen slice geometry
description: Compute union of NSScreen.screens frames; per screen derive offX, and the bottom-left to top-left Y flip (offYTop = union.h - offYBottom - screen.h). One window per screen. Geometry in points.
design: STATIC WallpaperController only (no observer=blz.3, no web injection=blz.2, no test target=blz.4). NEW WallpaperController.swift (main-actor). PURE helper: 'nonisolated func computeLayout(_ frames:[CGRect]) -> (union:CGRect, slices:[WallpaperSliceGeometry])', INTERNAL (not private), ORDER-PRESERVING (slices[i] corresponds to frames[i], no sort/filter), union = frames.reduce(CGRect.null){ $0.union($1) } (CGRect.null identity so negative origins do not inflate), empty -> (.zero, []); per frame stageW=union.width stageH=union.height offX=frame.minX-union.minX offY=union.maxY-frame.maxY (the Y flip). struct WallpaperSliceGeometry { stageW,stageH,offX,offY: CGFloat } : Equatable. WallpaperController.build() (ONE-SHOT, guard: if records nonempty return): snapshot NSScreen.screens, computeLayout(screens.map(.frame)), write 'ONLYWALLPAPERS_WINDOWS count=N', per screen create WebWallpaperView(frame: NSRect(origin:.zero,size: screen.frame.size)) [UNCHANGED frame] + WallpaperWindow(screen:contentView:) [setFrame(screen.frame) UNCHANGED], orderFrontRegardless, logPlacement, and write one 'ONLYWALLPAPERS_SLICE did=<CGDirectDisplayID> win=<windowNumber> frame=<x>,<y>,<w>,<h> stageW=<sw> stageH=<sh> offX=<ox> offY=<oy> screen=<name>' (name LAST; numeric fields as %.4f). Store records as WallpaperScreenRecord { displayID: CGDirectDisplayID; window: WallpaperWindow; geometry } (VALUE types + window; do NOT retain NSScreen; read NSScreen only in build()). INVARIANT: offX/offY are stored+logged ONLY, NEVER applied to setFrame/contentRect/view frame.origin. Controller owns the #filePath->web/ dir resolution (copied verbatim; no WALLPAPER_WEB_DIR=94b.3). NO teardown() this task (blz.3 designs the flicker-safe rebuild). AppDelegate: default path -> wallpaperController = WallpaperController(); build() (no args); retain the controller; REMOVE the inline loop + wallpaperWindows array; fix the stale 'ow-blz.1 rebuilds on display change' comment (windows survive rebuild; ow-blz.3 does hot-plug); keep ready/policy/SIGINT/OW_WEBSPIKE. WebWallpaperView UNCHANGED (geometry stays on controller records; blz.2 adds the view param + injection). smoke-run.sh: keep existing window/loaded=ok asserts; ADD per-screen SLICE checks via awk+epsilon(~0.5): N SLICE lines == N; N distinct did=; all share stageW/stageH; min(offX)==0 and min(offY)==0; RECOMPUTE union from the logged frames and assert stageW/stageH == recomputed union w/h and offX==x-union.minX and offY==union.maxY-(y+h) per line; SLICE w,h == the loaded=ok frame=WxH for the same win; count==1 -> stageW==w,stageH==h,offX==0,offY==0. Do NOT touch the didChangeScreenParametersNotification guard (blz.1 adds no observer). Guards not tripped (controller uses WallpaperWindow/WebWallpaperView TYPES, not NSWindow/WKWebView literals).
notes: Done (zero BLOCKING on the first cold Codex pass). WallpaperController owns per-screen windows + computes union canvas + per-screen slice geometry. Verified on two 3840x2160 side-by-side displays: stageW=7680 (union), offX=0 and offX=3840 (correct placement), offY=0 (aligned, same height). The smoke oracle RECOMPUTES union + offX + the offY flip from the logged raw frames and asserts the implementation's logged values match (independent oracle). Known limitation (Grok #1, Codex NON-BLOCKING): aligned equal-height displays give offY=0 either way, so the Y-flip is a no-op on this hardware; unaligned/stacked/mixed-height cases are ow-blz.4 unit tests (computeLayout is nonisolated+internal+order-preserving and ready). offX/offY are data only (never applied to AppKit rects; window stays screen.frame). No web injection (ow-blz.2), no hot-plug observer (ow-blz.3), no teardown (ow-blz.3 designs the flicker-safe swap). Records stored by CGDirectDisplayID (not NSScreen). build() is one-shot with a re-entry guard.
close_reason: WallpaperController computes the union canvas + per-screen slice geometry (offX + the bottom-left to top-left offY flip, in points) and owns the per-screen windows (moved out of AppDelegate). Verified on two displays via a recompute smoke oracle (stageW=7680 union, offX=0/3840). Geometry is data only; nothing spans visually until ow-blz.2 injects + transforms. Pure computeLayout ready for ow-blz.4. Unblocks ow-blz.2 (web injection/transform), ow-blz.3 (hot-plug rebuild), ow-blz.4 (geometry unit tests).

title: Web asset resolution: Bundle.module + WALLPAPER_WEB_DIR override
description: Resolve web dir from WALLPAPER_WEB_DIR env (live editing, no rebuild) else the bundled copy. Package.swift resources copy the web folder.
design:
FINAL (post Codex co-scope + Grok red-team, all 9 objections ACCEPTED).
RESOLUTION (MainActor path, new helper or WallpaperController method; computeLayout stays nonisolated):
1. WALLPAPER_WEB_DIR: if set+non-empty: expand ~ (NSString.expandingTildeInPath), require absolute (hasPrefix /) else fail reason=not-absolute; require index.html at dir else fail reason=no-index; else ok source=env. NEVER touch Bundle.module when env is set (no silent fallback).
2. else Bundle.module.url(forResource:index withExtension:html subdirectory:web) -> deletingLastPathComponent = web dir; nil/missing -> fail source=bundle reason=no-index. (A wholly-missing resource bundle aborts inside the synthesized Bundle.module accessor; that is a packaging defect owned by ow-aad.5, not a graceful path.)
LOG (dedicated prefix, avoids collision with existing ONLYWALLPAPERS_WEB lines): ok => 'ONLYWALLPAPERS_WEB_RESOLVE status=ok source=env|bundle dir=<abs>'; fail => 'ONLYWALLPAPERS_WEB_RESOLVE status=fail source=env|bundle reason=<not-absolute|no-index> dir=<abs>' then exit(1) (Darwin EXIT_FAILURE) BEFORE any WKWebView. NOT NSApp.terminate (exits 0), NOT fatalError (134, no clean line). READY is already printed before build(); invalid test keys off status=fail + exit!=0.
PACKAGE.swift: remove exclude:[web]; add resources:[.copy(web)] (copy not process; preserves index.html+assets/ as a real dir for loadFileURL allowingReadAccessTo). NO child exclude of web/webspike (SwiftPM rejects a hole in a copied tree). Spike HTML ships in the dev bundle for now; webspike retirement stays its own bead.
WebWallpaperView UNCHANGED (takes absolute dir, keeps its own ONLYWALLPAPERS_WEB dir= log). Spike resolver in AppDelegate (OW_WEBSPIKE) UNCHANGED; the new fail-fast contract applies ONLY to the default (non-webspike) path. Document the split.
SCRIPTS: smoke default launch adds WALLPAPER_WEB_DIR to the unset list (env -u WALLPAPER_WEB_DIR -u OW_SPIKE -u OW_WEBSPIKE) and asserts ONLYWALLPAPERS_WEB_RESOLVE status=ok source=bundle. New checks (smoke or scripts/webdir-check.sh in same gate): override-ok (WALLPAPER_WEB_DIR=$REPO_ROOT/Sources/OnlyWallpapers/web abs -> status=ok source=env dir=that), override-fail (/nonexistent -> status=fail source=env reason=no-index AND exit!=0, a launch that EXPECTS termination), bundle hygiene ($(swift build --show-bin-path)/OnlyWallpapers_OnlyWallpapers.bundle/web/index.html exists). video-check: generate bg.mp4 BEFORE build, launch with env -u WALLPAPER_WEB_DIR so the BUNDLED clip plays (keep media gates). title: Framing controls: object-position reposition (vertical/horizontal) + zoom/scale
description: User (Anoop) wants to control the framing of the cover-cropped video. On the dual-4K span a 16:9 clip is cover-fit to the union, so top/bottom (or sides) get cropped; today you cannot choose WHICH band shows, and the interesting content can be chopped off (observed: bottom of 'midnight-fuel-stop' cut off, wanted to shift it down). Add: (1) object-position reposition (vertical and horizontal) so the user can pan the crop (CSS object-position on #bg, or an equivalent translate within #stage), and (2) a zoom/scale control (scale the video up within the cover frame). Per-wallpaper setting, persisted, and exposed via the menu-bar controls (ow-aqx.7). Interacts with the union-space cover crop (see known-limitations) and the spanning geometry (ow-blz.2); must stay continuous across the bezel. Keep the hardware video layer intact (do not apply a transform to the video PARENT; a transform on #bg itself or object-position is fine).
design:
FINAL (Opus + lean Codex co-scope + Grok red-team; Grok's objections ACCEPTED, notably the pan-formula flaw).
RENDER (no transform): REPOSITION via object-position AND zoom-slack offset, both from one pan pair panX/panY in [-1,1]; ZOOM via box-sizing #bg (not transform). Exact CSS from Grok (union stage S, zoom z>=1):
  objectPositionX% = (panX+1)/2*100 ; objectPositionY% = (panY+1)/2*100
  left% = 50*(1-z)*(1+panX) ; top% = 50*(1-z)*(1+panY)
  width% = height% = 100*z
At z=1 left=top=0 => pure object-position pan (the chopped-bottom fix). At z>1 both offsets add => a stage-sized window slides over the full cover-scaled source (so Move Left/Right works on a wide union when zoomed). object-fit:cover kept; filter brightness(1.01) kept. z<1 FORBIDDEN (black gutters). z in [1,2] step 0.1; pan in [-1,1] step 0.05.
CSS: pull #bg OFF the inset:0 rule; #bg sets top/left/width/height AND explicit right:auto/bottom:auto (else CSS overconstraint could solve width from left+right and the box math lies). #overlay keeps inset:0.
JS: applyFraming(config) is a PURE setter (no module var), exposed window.__setWallpaperFraming; applied at document-start from injected window.__wallpaperFraming. Do NOT call it from the geometry IIFE / applyGeometry (touching #bg on the ow-blz.3 survivor path risks a layer blank); percentages of #stage auto-reflow on stage resize, so no reapply needed for CSS.
NATIVE pending-framing state machine (mirror geometry FIX-2): AppStorageManager owns currentFraming + config.json (sibling of web/ under appSupportRoot, OW_APP_SUPPORT_DIR honored, survives code reseed). Send framing via (1) document-start injection read from CURRENT AppStorageManager state in WebWallpaperView.init, (2) re-send on didFinish (pending, last-write-wins like latestGeometry - fixes the nudge-between-init-and-didFinish drop), (3) broadcast via evaluateJavaScript __setWallpaperFraming to every live view on a menu nudge. Framing applies even in bundle-fallback mode (picker disabled).
PERSISTENCE: per-field clamp (one bad field -> that field default, keep others); round to 2 decimals (or integer ticks) on write to avoid float drift; CLAMP + finite-guard BEFORE JSONSerialization (a NaN/inf injected into the WKUserScript could throw and kill the whole document-start script incl geometry); atomic write config.json.partial -> replaceItemAt; unwritable -> apply live, skip persist, log.
MENU (StatusItemController): a Framing submenu above Quit: Move Up/Down/Left/Right, Zoom In/Out, Reset Framing. Each nudges (clamped) -> persist -> controller.applyFraming broadcast.
ZOOM SAFETY (unspiked hardware layer): a gate + Phase 5 must confirm the video KEEPS PLAYING (media=playing) after a z=2 framing apply and across a resize (resizing #bg is a layer-size change; ow-blz.2 banned transforms for a sibling reason). If it blanks, ship PAN-ONLY v1 and defer zoom.
GATES: per-view ONLYWALLPAPERS_FRAMING readback (getComputedStyle USED px width/height + used object-position), assert they reflect injected non-default framing on EVERY view and are IDENTICAL across records (continuity = identity); nudge via a DEDICATED framing test hook (NOT SIGUSR2 which is video reload) + assert the readback changed AND config.json round-tripped; clamp tests (z<1 rejected, out-of-range pan clamped); zoom-liveness (media=playing at z=2); fake-screens hot-plug add -> newcomer gets CURRENT framing. Keep all existing gates green.
PHASE 5: photograph the bezel at z=1.5 panY=1 on the real 2-display glass; confirm zoom liveness; confirm Move Left/Right works when zoomed.
FUTURE: object-view-box is the cleaner CSS (pan+zoom without box resize) but is flagged off on Tahoe 26.5; do not bet on it. BOUNDARY: fuller controls surface = ow-aqx.7; mood/tint = ow-aqx.1.
acceptance_criteria: The user can reposition the video crop vertically/horizontally and zoom in, the change persists, and the result stays continuous across displays.

title: Bounce / ping-pong loop option (seamless, no loop seam)
description: User request (Anoop): a bounce / ping-pong loop so a clip plays forward then backward and never shows a loop seam. TECHNICAL CONSTRAINT: HTML5 <video> cannot play in reverse at runtime (negative playbackRate is not supported in WebKit; JS frame-by-frame reverse is janky and CPU heavy). So bounce must be achieved by PRE-PROCESSING the clip into a boomerang (forward + reversed concatenated into one file), which then loops seamlessly with the existing loop attribute. Implementation: a small ffmpeg helper / flag that takes a source clip and emits a boomerang bg.mp4 (e.g. split, reverse the copy, concat), plus docs. Optionally surface it as a per-video option in the config (ow-aqx.2). Note: boomerang doubles the clip length and file size, and the midpoint (the forward end / reverse start) must be a real frame to avoid a 1-frame stutter.
acceptance_criteria: A documented helper produces a boomerang bg.mp4 that plays forward then backward and loops with no visible seam; optionally selectable per video in config.

title: True WKWebView desktop-through transparency on macOS 26 (public path is opaque)
description: Finding from ow-94b.1: on macOS 26 the public WKWebView transparency path (underPageBackgroundColor=.clear + transparent html/body CSS) does NOT make the base transparent; it renders opaque (an screencapture -l of the window interior comes back opaque, not the black that a truly transparent buffer yields). The de-facto macOS fix is the semi-private KVC setValue(false, forKey: 'drawsBackground'), which the project chose to avoid. For now WebWallpaperView uses an opaque base with a black CSS fallback, and the full-bleed video covers it, so the wallpaper itself is unaffected. This task is only needed when an Epic D overlay/blend effect actually needs the real desktop to show THROUGH the web layer. Then decide: accept the drawsBackground KVC (document the private-API risk), or find a public macOS 26 approach (overriding isOpaque, a transparent CALayer host, an alternate view). Verify with a hollow-interior page: screencapture -D of an uncovered display must show the real desktop through the interior.
acceptance_criteria: Either a public macOS 26 approach yields a genuinely transparent WKWebView base (desktop visible through a hollow page region in a -D display capture), or the drawsBackground KVC is adopted with the private-API risk documented and a fallback if it breaks.

title: Multi-display slice sync + pause/resume when displays are on different Spaces
description: Surfaced during the ow-94b.5 web-video de-risk (observed by Anoop on macOS 26.5.2). The spanned canvas (DEC-002) is one screen-sized WKWebView window PER display, each showing a slice of one oversized stage, with an independent video decode per screen (see known-limitations). Observed per-window behavior: a display whose desktop Space is visible keeps animating; a display taken into a full-screen app Space has its wallpaper slice PAUSED (occlusion/Space culling) and RESUMES when returning to the desktop Space (not frozen). OPEN QUESTIONS for the spanned design: (1) When one display is in a full-screen Space while the other stays on the desktop, does the still-visible slice keep animating (expected yes) and does the hidden slice pause independently (expected yes)? (2) CRITICAL: when the paused slice resumes, is it FRAME-SYNCED with the other slice, or does it drift, breaking the continuous-across-the-bezel image? Investigate a shared playback clock / periodic resync (e.g. seek both <video> elements to a common wall-clock-derived time) so slices stay aligned across pause/resume and across independent decodes. Reuse the ow-94b.5 telemetry (currentTime per window) to measure drift.
acceptance_criteria: The spanned wallpaper keeps a single continuous image across displays, and slices stay frame-aligned (within tolerance) after one display pauses/resumes due to Spaces, verified by comparing per-window currentTime.

title: Minimal config (video choice, mood toggle)
description: A small config.json or env-driven config for which video to play and whether moods are on. No settings UI yet.
design:
FINAL (Opus + lean Codex co-scope + Grok red-team; Grok's verdict 'do not implement as written', all objections ACCEPTED). Keeps the locked single-slot copy-into-app-storage decision + loadFileURL co-location; revises the rest.
STORAGE/SEED: appSupportRoot() = env OW_APP_SUPPORT_DIR (tests) else ~/Library/Application Support/OnlyWallpapers. seedWebDirIfNeeded(from bundleWebDir) runs ONCE from AppDelegate.applicationDidFinishLaunching BEFORE initialBuild() - NEVER from resolve() or performCommit (those run on every hot-plug rebuild; seeding there would rewrite live code under N running views). Seeds appSupport/web/ with index.html+style.css+wallpaper.js ONLY when missing OR CFBundleVersion/content-hash differs; copies the 3 as a unit (web/.seed-tmp -> atomic rename); NEVER touches assets/ (user video persists). Deletes leftover *.partial + replacement dirs on seed (no-growth). Seeds a default bg.mp4 only when the slot is missing AND true-first-run/test.
RESOLVER (pure tier pick, no mutation): WALLPAPER_WEB_DIR (fail-fast, unchanged) -> seeded appSupport/web/ (must hold index.html) -> BUNDLE FALLBACK if seed failed/unwritable (installed app must still wallpaper). Log source=env|appstore|bundle. (Widening allowingReadAccessTo cannot work: common ancestor of /Applications and ~/Library is /; co-location is the least-WebKit-surface fix. No WKURLSchemeHandler in v1 - CORS+range+document-serving.)
PICKER: AppDelegate owns WallpaperController+StatusItemController; passes a closure/coordinator to the status item (NO window discovery). 'Choose video...' above Quit. Action (MainActor): picking=true + disable item; NSApp.activate() (Tahoe API, not deprecated activate(ignoringOtherApps:)); DispatchQueue.main.async; NSOpenPanel canChooseFiles, no dirs/multi, allowedContentTypes=[.mpeg4Movie] (v1 MP4-ONLY: a .mov onto bg.mp4 with type=video/mp4 paints black), level>=.modalPanel, directoryURL=Movies; runModal(). On OK: copy off-main via Task.detached/nonisolated helper -> Result to appSupport/web/assets/bg.mp4.partial (SAME dir) then FileManager.replaceItemAt into bg.mp4; check free space; log ONLYWALLPAPERS_VIDEO slot=ok|fail bytes=. Back on MainActor reloadVideo() + re-enable. Picker ALWAYS writes to app storage (never the WALLPAPER_WEB_DIR source tree); in dev (WALLPAPER_WEB_DIR set) disable the item or document. copyInFlight lock prevents re-entry.
RELOAD (preserve ow-blz.3): IN-PLACE JS swap window.__setWallpaperVideo(src) that removes <source> children, sets video.src=assets/bg.mp4?rev=token, load()/play() - NOT webView.reload() (its document-start userscript carries only INIT geometry + does not reset isLoaded -> wrong-slice flash + fights hot-plug). Keep the STATIC HTML src='assets/bg.mp4' stable (smoke shape guard). ?rev on file:// is UNVERIFIED on Tahoe -> PROVE in Phase 5; fallback ladder: (1) video.load() same URL (inode/mtime), (2) reloadFromOrigin()+reset isLoaded on didStartProvisionalNavigation+apply latestGeometry in didFinish, (3) unique sibling assets/bg.<token>.mp4 + launch sweeper (definite path-cache bust). Coordinate across ALL views.
GATES (same PR, OW_APP_SUPPORT_DIR=temp on EVERY launch so they never touch the user's real app storage): new resolver gate (default -> source=appstore, dir under temp, code byte-identical to bundle, loaded=ok); bundle-fallback test (unwritable seed -> source=bundle loads); package-check (temp override + seed source = the .app's OWN bundle, no /.build/); smoke/webdir/video-check/rebuild-check updated for source=appstore + OW_APP_SUPPORT_DIR temp; MEDIA-SWITCH gate (extend video-check): clip A -> media=playing; replace slot with clip B (diff duration/loggable currentSrc); test hook runs reloadVideo; assert currentSrc has new rev AND late media=playing. PERSISTENCE = slot existence.
PHASE 5 (manual on user's machine): pick while Safari focused / full-screen app / from Downloads (TCC); pick+delete source+relaunch packaged .app; CONFIRM the ?rev cache-bust actually swaps (else fallback ladder). FOLLOW-UP: 'Reset to bundled default' (delete slot + re-seed). Mood toggle still deferred.
notes: PHASE 5 CONFIRMED by user (2026-10-07): ran the app in app-storage mode, clicked the menu-bar 'Choose video...', the NSOpenPanel opened and took focus (the accessory-app panel-focus question - resolved: works), picked a video, and the wallpaper swapped in place across all 3 screens with NO hiccups/black flash. Accidentally quit mid-switch and it relaunched + resumed fine (persistence confirmed). User: 'works great! ... relaunched fine and resumed. no hiccups at all!'. Final gate-safety fixes landed (video-check backup cannot delete the user's source bg.mp4 on a failed backup; copy-hook asserts durationMs+playing per ACTUAL window). Feature complete.

title: Transient real-wallpaper reveals during system transitions (widget drag, Space switch)
description: Our desktop-layer window is briefly replaced by the REAL system wallpaper during some system-driven transitions, then our content returns. Two observed instances on macOS 26.5.2 (ow-mbw.1 spike): (1) WIDGET DRAG: while dragging a desktop widget (clock, calendar), the real wallpaper (dimmed) shows in place of our window for the drag duration, returning on drop. (2) FULL-SCREEN TO DESKTOP SPACE SWITCH: navigating (cmd+arrow / swipe) from a full-screen app Space back to the desktop Space, the old/real wallpaper flashes for about a second during the slide animation before our window appears. Same class: the compositor shows the true desktop during the transition and our desktop-level window paints a beat late. Likely related to Mission Control / Space-transition surface snapshotting. Investigate whether either is preventable (window level/flags, reacting to transition notifications); may be inherent system behavior. Belongs with Spaces/lifecycle work (see ow-aad.1). Low priority.
design: Do NOT assume this is unfixable: research what macOS actually does during widget drag (widget-edit mode compositing, whether our desktop-level window can stay visible, any notifications for enter/exit widget-edit, window level/flags options). Candidate fallbacks if the reveal cannot be fully prevented: (1) PREFERRED: on drag/widget-edit start, grab a freeze-frame (thumbnail of the current rendered frame) and show it so the swap looks seamless, restoring live render on drag end; needs a way to detect widget-edit start quickly. (2) LOWER: set the user's actual system wallpaper to solid black so that whatever the OS reveals during widget drag is just black (not an unrelated photo), which looks intentional rather than jarring. Priority stays P3: user rarely drags widgets once placed.
acceptance_criteria: Documented behavior; if avoidable, our window stays visible during widget drag, otherwise the limitation is recorded.
notes: User guidance (Anoop): dig deeper and research, do not assume can/cannot be done. Low priority because widgets are rarely dragged once set.
